<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Monetary policy outlook:</strong> SBI Research suggests the RBI may hike the repo rate by 50 basis points in December to combat persistent inflation, which currently stands at 5.5%.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I9</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Debt market volatility:</strong> Indian debt funds face a potential $4.5 billion selloff as the RBI signals further rate hikes and tightens liquidity, pushing bond yields to three-year highs.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I8</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Market performance:</strong> The Sensex and Nifty have declined as surging crude oil prices and ongoing geopolitical conflicts in Ukraine and the Middle East dampen investor sentiment.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I6</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>FII outflows:</strong> Foreign Institutional Investor selling has accelerated, resulting in a withdrawal of approximately Rs 41,000 crore over the past eight days, weighing on domestic market liquidity.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W3</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Global market sentiment:</strong> US indices, particularly the Nasdaq, ended lower as rising oil prices and anticipation of upcoming earnings reports created a cautious environment for global equities.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W4</a></span></li>
</ul>
